profile.headline: Software Engineer at Susquehanna Interational Group, LLP (SIG)
profile.summary: Since 2009 I have worked as a Software Architect and ultimately as a Principal Architect designing applications and systems in the .NET space from Windows and SQL Server to now Linux on Kubernetes in Azure in the Healthcarej, insurance and finance industries.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Strategic Planning · Software Architecture · Technical Leadership · Design Patterns · MongoDB · React.js · Cost Management

positions.title: Manager, Software Architecture - Product Development
positions.description: Architected a greenfield zero-downtime microservices web based public facing system built on top of Kubernetes/AKS, Istio, .NET core on Linux, VueJS, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, RabbitMQ while meeting HIPAA/HITRUST regulations in the healthcare sector,

positions.title: Principal Architect
positions.description: - Migrated/Modernized 10 year old legacy .NET code to a modern architecture compatible with .NET core.  Utilizing SOLID principles, the code migrated was established with DI and unit testable code.  The converted code went from 0 unit tests to > 50,000 within a year.  Designed unit test patterns that were scalable utilizing DataRow test case concepts.  Code quality increased significantly, performance was measurable and code coverage was able to be enforced through CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.  This change caused an emormous reduction in manual test regression and moving to fully automated with each code check-in.  The code that was migrated is fully compatible with .NET core for future upgrades.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Skills: Strategic Planning · Software Architecture · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · Technical Leadership · Enterprise Architecture · Design Patterns · MongoDB · Cost Management · Management

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Design systems, components, and services for all software developed at the company.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
OncoIQ Application (Case Management Application)
Starting as a lone developer, we introduced a dynamic application developed in ASP.Net 3.4 & SQL Server 2008.  The application allowed case managers to manage patient's cases of cancer.  The application incorporated tasking for each case manager, enabled clinical smarts by coding treatments that the doctor is providing and matching these treatments to well established but very complex regimen rules.  This allowed nurses to verify that the doctor is following well established practices.

Clinical API 1.0
During the development of OncoIQ, we began our initial design of a Clinical API.  This incorporated a set of .net class libraries that modeled regimens, treatment plans, drugs, cancer, biomarkers and more.

Migration from SharePoint to OncoIQ
Once OncoIQ was deployed, as a one man shop, I handled support, security, design, bug tracking etc.  Wore many hats, worked many nights to support the application.  The application allowed the company to manage cases like never before and allowed keen insight into case data and trends.

positions.title: BSS Consultant
positions.description: Created ASP.Net internal reporting sites on the claims & premiums systems working with databases and tables with over 130+ million records.
